_note: Reference standard for the 40-study validation sample (Reviewer 1, comment 4). For each study (S01-S40 in the order of kwic_sample.json) 'used' lists the classifications judged APPLIED in that study (as data source, computed index, or method/platform actually run, including baselines); every other classification is judged not used. Derived thematic products count as use of the sensor (e.g. MOD13 -> MODIS, GIMMS NDVI -> AVHRR, Landsat-based land cover product -> Landsat); DEMs and figure backdrops do not. 'domain_ok' is 1 if the primary-domain label is the best-fitting of the ten categories (or 'Unclassified' where none fits). Labels were assigned by reading every passage in which the term or a broader synonym occurs (kwic_sample.json); edit this file to override any label and re-run score_validation.py.
